observational_model.formula: photographic species-equal white ROI percentage points ~ log(1+year-VIIRS median) + log_light×centered log10(island area km2) + log_light×centered log10(1+nearest mainland coast-vertex km) + log(1+year-WorldPop UC density) + WorldClim BIO5 + log(1+BIO12) + elevation + log(1+source photo opportunities) + island fixed effects + original observation-year fixed effects
observational_model.photo_units: photo-cell year (not original image or independent flora species)
observational_model.island_equal_weight: each sampled independent GSHHG island has total weight one
observational_model.multi_site_requirement: at least two actual different 0.05-degree geographic sites and two nightlight levels per GSHHG island

historical_main_comparison.meaning: historical-main 2019/2021/2023/2024/2025 original-photo 5-photo/3-species island cohort; not exchangeable with independently island-targeted new source

new_tier06.reason: only eight independent multi-site GSHHG islands; below preregistered ten-island model threshold

ecological_interpretation.replication_of_historical_positive_area_: not reproduced by the new island/site-targeted photographed species-equal ROI9 source
ecological_interpretation.positive_nightlight_effect_excluded: no; CI includes positive and negative slopes; not evidence of a zero causal effect
ecological_interpretation.source_detection_and_botanical_stage_lim: original photo ROI9 not independently verified native flowering petals, pigment genotype or effective nocturnal pollination
ecological_interpretation.design_dependence: observational photos and selected island/site sampling schemes differ; the geographic and taxonomic support is not exchangeable with old historical-main
ecological_interpretation.new_source_only_repeated_island_coverage: 35 of 75 strict-source islands have at least two genuine different geographic sites; one largest island supplies 46% of model cell years
